look_here_first: WARTY FRUIT FIRST. This hairless leafy annual has spoon-shaped to oblanceolate alternate lower stem leaves, tiny terminal cyathia, and repeated forks with broad green flowering bracts. Its ripe 3-lobed capsule shows distinct LOW ROUNDED WARTS (now photographed, with arrows); Roemer's spurge (E. roemeriana) has a SMOOTH fruit and two rounded flowering bracts fused into a shallow cup roughly halfway up. E. spathulata has distinct (not fused) bracts, often fine-toothed at the rim, and 4–5 hornless cyathial glands. Existing Texas Nathan Taylor and University of Arizona Max Licher photos now show the warty fruit, styles, yellow cyathial structures, and leaflike bracts; bract-base fusion geometry and absent horns remain hand-lens/closer-macro confirmations. County nativity badge has not been audited.

key_traits.label: Family pattern
key_traits.text: Euphorbiaceae; upright leafy Euphorbia subgenus Esula with tiny cyathia (specialized flowering units) rather than ordinary petals.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Hairless annual with slender upright, often basally branched shoots and repeatedly forked terminal reproductive branches.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Stem leaves alternate and typically spatulate to oblanceolate, usually with finely serrulate margins; inspect several mature leaves rather than only bracts.

key_traits.label: Paired bracts
key_traits.text: Paired upper dichasial bracts separate (distinct), often broadly ovate or triangular, sometimes with fine-toothed edges; not half-fused as in E. roemeriana.

key_traits.label: Cyathia
key_traits.text: Small green cup-like flowering units; 4–5 nectar glands without horns, requiring strong close-up to verify.

key_traits.label: Fruit
key_traits.text: Mature capsule shallowly 3-lobed and covered with small LOW ROUNDED verrucae (warts), a key difference from the smooth capsules of E. roemeriana.

key_traits.label: Seed
key_traits.text: Variable brown to dark-purple seeds; smooth, finely ridged or netlike-reticulate surfaces across geographic populations. Do not impose a universal reticulate seed texture on Texas specimens.

key_traits.label: Source note
key_traits.text: Flora of North America, Euphorbia spathulata Lam. (taxon_id=242416545). Native-by-county review is paused; FNA is used for anatomy, not a finished Hays BONAP/NAPA badge.
